title: GCS ancestry total and library cost adjudications
summary: Generated by scripts/review-gcs-adjudicate.mjs. Every exact-identity cost discrepancy is adjudicated against the published GURPS cost tables, and every source-total reconciliation entry is classified and documented. No record is left with an unexplained point-total difference. Opening each .gct in GCS to confirm the displayed ancestry total, and to replace reconciliation children with native constructions where the grouped ability can be decomposed, remains a manual step and is named per record.
